findings.summary: write() holds the non-reentrant Logger.mu while calling Formatter.Format, so any formatter, String() or MarshalJSON that logs via the same logger or calls SetFormatter/SetOutput/SetReportCaller/AddHook will deadlock, and formatting is serialized across goroutines, hurting hot-path performance.
TestEntryReportCallerRace and TestEntryFormatterRace spawn goroutines without waiting (no sync.WaitGroup), so tests may finish before goroutines run and the race detector often detects nothing.
Comment claims logging occurs before SetReportCaller but nothing guarantees that ordering.
The goroutine added in TestEntryReportCallerRace duplicates an existing one.
The word 'likelyhood' is misspelled in a comment.
